description: Bypass test BT-02 (Phase 4B punch-out bypass testing) found that when systems/eval-harness/guardrail-checkpoint.py is called with result=escalate but no in-progress eval record exists for the workflow, it prints a warning, records nothing, and exits 0. A genuine punch-out in that window is silently dropped: the workflow halts but no durable record of the escalation exists anywhere.
correction: An unrecordable escalate must fail loudly: exit non-zero so the calling step sees the failure, and warn that the escalation was not durably recorded so the operator (David) is surfaced as the fallback sink.
systemic_fix: Fix applied in guardrail-checkpoint.py: when result is escalate and no in-progress record is found after retries, the script exits 2 (distinct from the generic validation exit 1) with a loud warning naming the human operator as the fallback punch-out. Re-test to be captured in projects/stage-4-evidence/bypass-tests/ during the data window.
